description: Validate an EU VAT identification number against the European Commission's VIES service. Returns validity and, where disclosed by the member state, registered name and address. Live tool – free during the pilot, rate-limited.

country_code.description: EU member state code, e.g. DE, FR, EL (Greece), XI (Northern Ireland). Optional if vat_number has a prefix.

vat_number.description: VAT number, with or without country prefix, e.g. DE123456789.

name: check_eu_vat
title: Validate EU VAT number (VIES)
